description: Machine-consumable form of the routing schema. Companion to task-routing.schema.yaml (which is the documented human-readable form). Keep both in sync.

phases.name: probe
escalate_when: Acceptance criteria are not extractable from the task description

phases.name: execute
escalate_when: Same action repeated more than 3 times without progress
Reaching a tool boundary not declared in the task profile

phases.name: verify
escalate_when: Verifier crashes or returns unparseable output
Verifier passes but observed behavior contradicts goal

global_stop: Action would be irreversible and verifier is weak or absent
Required context for the next phase is missing
Phase escalation triggered more than N times without resolution
agent_instruction: Work in phases. Probe first: list acceptance criteria into the ledger, including a verifier command. Then execute incrementally, writing each action and its observation. Run the verifier before claiming success. Only stop when the verifier exits with success and the ledger reflects every acceptance criterion. Escalate if the verifier crashes, if the same action repeats without progress, or if a tool boundary not in the task profile is reached.
